summary: Verified new collapsible drill-down tree UI + Expand All/Collapse All + regression on stats and data. Backend response now returns `tree` (nested) instead of flat `rows`; rewrote backend_test.py to walk the tree and re-validate 91/5 for FLT2_4.1 and 23/2 for 8060522_1. All 12 backend tests pass. All frontend flows work exactly as specified: default drill-down shows only level-1 rows, chevron toggles children in/out, Expand All reveals full tree, Collapse All returns to level-1 only, fresh search resets collapse state, bare-part-number resolution + resolved badge, invalid-BOM error alert, SAP Connected indicator green.
action_items: Minor doc mismatch: the review request states 8060522_1 has 8 Level-1 rows, but SAP actually returns 10 Level-1 rows (total_components is still 23 as expected). Behaviour is correct; only the task description count was off. No code fix required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend response shape uses `tree` (List[BomNode] with nested `children`) - do NOT use the old `rows` field. Use flatten_tree() helper in backend_test.py. For 8060522_1: 10 Level-1 root nodes, 23 total (task description of '8 level-1' is inaccurate; SAP returns 10). FLT2_4.1: 16 Level-1 root nodes, 91 total, max_level 5. Frontend testids: bom-row-{path} (e.g. bom-row-0, bom-row-0-1), bom-toggle-{path}, expand-all-button, collapse-all-button. Level indentation confirmed: 12px @ L1, 32px @ L2 (20px per level). Correct preview URL: https://sap-data-sync.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT sapbom.preview...).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects. Only reported the doc count discrepancy (8 vs 10 Level-1 rows for 8060522_1).
